title: $10 off, No Minimum Spend @ Nashie
body:
Deal: $10 off, No Minimum Spend @ Nashie

[chrism238] Product (shirts) are good. Perhaps a little bigger than their claimed size, and dries a little slower than anticipated, but no complaints.
[silverham] Any idea if these are allowed at public pools with strict clothing requirements? Eg no "t-shirts", no lose clothing at Sydney OlympicPark Aquatic Centre etc.
[prkr] It’s swimwear so I’d find it very odd if one got any grief for it (especially after explaining).
[30year old Camry] They only go up to size 6XL so I don't think they will fit me.
[starbearer] you looking to buy for yourself or your camry
[Slo20] Discount code applied without logging in so it’s not tied to account. Having said that, cheapest thing looks like an overpriced $50 cap (plus shipping)
[prkr] Stupid marketing. I find it a bit dirty.
[Jimothy Wongingtons] It’s definitely height of scumbaggery yet somehow still better than many other sellers online these days
[Jimothy Wongingtons] So technically not a store credit, just a coupon off. Nashie marketing 👎
Prepare to also get absolutely bombarded with targeted ads from them too once you start browsing.
I don’t mind the Nashie itself. I have a long sleeve and a short sleeve one. I don’t recommend unless on sale. The rrp is ridiculous
I also have the Nashie shorts too- can’t recommend those.
[tomwhiteallnight] Anyone found the same shirt on AliExpress or Taobao for cheaper?
[Jimothy Wongingtons] Surprisingly no, I can only assume this type of product is not popular enough to rip off.
[thedavemiester] Yes, but no where near the quality. I have 1 AliExpress (look for fishing shirt or upf 50+ shirt) and now 5 nashies (thanks kids).
[thedavemiester] Quality product, but very annoying marketing. It's relentless
